eod.conclusion: Indian equities closed lower after failing to hold intraday gains, with banking stocks underperforming. Early optimism from declining volatility gave way to caution ahead of earnings season, while global rate concerns and sector-specific developments influenced sentiment. The benchmarks' retreat reflected profit-taking after three sessions of advances.
